name: marketak
description: Marketak - delivery platform. One city at a time, lunch service first. Arabic-first, customer + rider in one binary.

scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run test:integrity && npm run check:secrets && npm run check:hardcoded-colors && npm run check:policies && npm run check:status-types

comments.typescriptPin: TypeScript is pinned to ~6.0.3 rather than latest (7.0.2), and the pin is deliberate. typescript-eslint@8.71.1 declares peer `typescript >=4.8.4 <6.1.0`, so TS7 refuses to install alongside the linter. 6.0.3 is the newest release inside the range the linter supports. Bump both together when typescript-eslint widens its peer range; do not --force past it, because a mismatched parser is how a lint rule silently stops seeing the file. Verified 2026-10-09 against `npm view typescript-eslint@8.71.1 peerDependencies`.
comments.dependencyCruiser: Rules 2 and 3 of the mobile architecture are enforced twice on purpose: ESLint's native `no-restricted-imports` catches a forbidden import at the statement, and `apps/mobile/.dependency-cruiser.cjs` catches one laundered through a re-export. An `eslint-plugin-dependency-cruiser` package exists at 0.1.1 but exposes no usable rule, so neither layer depends on it.
